body:
New MODE_TYLER=109. Real STATE_SPECTATOR wisp (no-clip free-fly, made real for the first time -- defined for years, never read by collision/gravity code). packages/simulation/tyler_coldopen.{h,c}: 8-beat Half-Life scripted_sequence coordinator driving story_ai_trigger_scripted, dispatching new REFLUX_ACTION_TYLER_BEAT + existing REFLUX_ACTION_BUTTON_PRESSED. New scriptable exit primitive story_force_level_transition (factored out of story_check_level_exits' proven body), fired directly by the coordinator's final beat, no LevelExit volume authored. Two real levels live in IDUNA's NOCK registry (TYLER_VALHANNA_ICELAND_1986 id24, CONSTRUCT id23) via new IDUNA/cmd/nock_gen_tyler_levels. Two real PARENA-generated procedural textures (institutional tile, ECS screen glow) via new IDUNA/cmd/nock_gen_textures + PARENA/stdlib/shankpit/textures/*.prn. Third-person Duck camera (AI_KIT_LEELA mannequin) ports PAPERCRAFT's own real orbit-cam formula into SHANKPIT's existing cx/cz/cam_y mechanism. make server/make lobby both build clean. Live-verified end to end server-side: MODE_SELECTED mode=109 -> TYLER_COLDOPEN_STARTED -> all 8 beats -> STORY_LEVEL_TRANSITION next_level_id=23 firing against the live IDUNA registry. Honest gaps named in docs2/specs/TYLER_VALHANNA_MODE_NORTHSTAR.md: rigid body is a marker only (real backend already exists, rigid_ragdoll.c); subtitle rendering + coordinator only reach LOCAL single-player mode (REFLUX has no wire packet); no client rendering visually verified (no GL driver in sandbox).

⚓ ☃
title: MODE_TYLER: TYLER VALHANNA cold open as a real SHANKPIT game mode (S536 BIG_O demo)
